title: Task Manager: Disambiguate same app installed from different sources
line: When the same app is pinned or open twice from different sources, the Task Manager tooltip now says which one is the Flatpak or Snap.
explanation: The Task Manager only showed the app's name in tooltips, so a distro Firefox and a Flatpak Firefox (same name, same icon) looked identical. The change adds a backend helper that reads the desktop file's X-Flatpak or X-SnapInstanceName key, and the tooltip heading appends "(Flatpak)" or "(Snap)" only when another task or launcher in the same Task Manager has the same name but a different desktop file.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: show the app's source when two apps share a name

The same app installed from the distro and as a Flatpak or Snap showed
two identical tooltips. When another task has the same name, the tooltip
heading now says where the app came from, like "Firefox (Flatpak)".

BUG: 500695

media.caption: Three pinned "Text Editor" launchers (distro, Flatpak, Snap): all tooltips just say "Text Editor"
Open windows of the distro and Flatpak versions: the window tooltip heading tells them apart too
